title: 17 former Arizona players make initial NFL rosters

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 17 former Arizona players make initial NFL rosters
sources.description: Sunday was cutdown day in the NFL, with each team forced to get their roster down to 53 from upwards of 90 during training camp. And when the dust settled, quick a few players with ties to Arizona made the cut. A total of 17 former Wildcats are on the initial 53-man rosters submitted to […]
